description: A bearded man with a laurel wreath and dark curls rides a black horse at the front of a column of armored soldiers in red capes and helmets. He wears a silver cuirass over a red tunic. Behind him is a stone archway and a city with classical temple buildings under smoky, orange-lit skies, with red standards and spears raised. The painting fills the frame edge to edge in a dramatic oil style. No visible text.
